'''Borman''' is the innkeeper of the [[Inn of the Golden Cup]] in [[Tanchico]].
== History ==
Borman is running the inn when [[Nadira]] requests a room in his establishment.<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
